## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A hook test shows a worker turn ending with no in-flight work, no pending...

The system SHALL ensure that a hook test shows a worker turn ending with no in-flight work, no pending decision card, and no terminal loop-state is blocked with a message asking the worker to state what it is waiting on.

#### Scenario: A hook test shows a worker turn ending with no in-flight work, no pending...

WHEN `add-a-stop-hook-turn-end-guard-for-worker-sessions` is implemented
THEN A hook test shows a worker turn ending with no in-flight work, no pending decision card, and no terminal loop-state is blocked with a message asking the worker to state what it is waiting on.

### Requirement: Hook tests show turns ending with in-flight work, with a schema-valid...

The system SHALL ensure that hook tests show turns ending with in-flight work, with a schema-valid pending card, or with terminal loop-state are allowed through.

#### Scenario: Hook tests show turns ending with in-flight work, with a schema-valid...

WHEN `add-a-stop-hook-turn-end-guard-for-worker-sessions` is implemented
THEN Hook tests show turns ending with in-flight work, with a schema-valid pending card, or with terminal loop-state are allowed through.

### Requirement: The guard is installed into worker sessions only and does not fire in the...

The system SHALL ensure that the guard is installed into worker sessions only and does not fire in the Supervisor session or ordinary interactive sessions.

#### Scenario: The guard is installed into worker sessions only and does not fire in the...

WHEN `add-a-stop-hook-turn-end-guard-for-worker-sessions` is implemented
THEN The guard is installed into worker sessions only and does not fire in the Supervisor session or ordinary interactive sessions.
